trusted_assumptions: The smaller std APIs f64::to_bits and f64::from_bits preserve the modeled IEEE bit pattern.
axiom_f64_neg_ensures_ieee: vstd's opaque neg_ensures relation models Rust's bitwise IEEE unary negation by toggling the sign bit.
rationale: Rust 1.96's neg_impl! expands to -self. The compiler primitive is faithfully lowered to an IEEE sign-bit toggle without calling Neg::neg.
